summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, announcing its inclusion in the VanEck Gold Miners ETF (GDX) effective after market close on June 19, 2026, as part of GDX's quarterly rebalance. The press release, furnished as Exhibit 99.1, states the company (TSX: AYA; NASDAQ: AYA) is a Canadian precious metals miner with Moroccan assets, including the Zgounder silver mine and Boumadine project. No specific deal terms, prices, or strategic changes are provided. This is a routine index inclusion announcement, not a special situation requiring categorization under defined event types.
